toolchain.linker: rust-lld 22.1.8, the toolchain's own, driven by cc (GCC 16.2.1)
toolchain.minimum_from: the nushell 0.116.1 crates; of the pins, russh 0.65.0 declares the highest, 1.89

notes: It pins pre-releases exactly: ssh-key =0.7.0-rc.11 and rsa =0.10.0-rc.18, with pkcs1 0.8.0-rc.4.
check_server_key receives PublicKeyOrCertificate, a raw host key or an SSH host certificate.
Preferred::DEFAULT offers no host-certificate algorithms and lists ssh-rsa, SHA-1 RSA signatures, last.
SHA-1 is compiled in through russh and ssh-key's sha1 feature; MD5 through legacy PEM key decryption.
The Unix agent client, connect_uds and connect_env, is compiled in and opens a socket only when called.
Only its own tests spawn processes, ssh-agent and ssh-add.
pageant is a Windows-only dependency, outside the Linux build graph.
It declares no rust-version; the workspace's minimum governs it.
It runs over the stream it is given and opens no socket or process of its own.

resolution.kept: every version the lock held before the pins' first consumers, 768

remote_channel.transport: mTLS, kept as built and apart from engine SSH

package_inputs.use: the gram equip the package carries

update_rules: A pin moves only to another exact version, its checksum, license, rust-version, and features recorded here in the same commit.
A dependency upgrade reruns the trust and platform rows it touches on Linux x86_64 and riscv64; a regenerated lock alone is no evidence.
A codec or schema change ships with wire fixtures for every changed message.
russh keeps its defaults off with ring and rsa alone: no aws-lc-rs, compression, DSA, or 3DES.
The nushell crates move together at one version, with the plugins built from this workspace.
Cargo.lock is committed, and every build and check runs with --locked.
A build records its effective rustc, cargo, linker, and target; one below the minimum is refused.
